lines: Sikkhe nibbānamattanoti attano rāgādīnaṃ nibbānatthāya adhisīlādīni sikkheyya.
Evaṃ vutte attamano dhotako bhagavantaṃ abhitthavamāno kathaṃkathāpamokkhaṃ yācanto “passāmahan”ti gāthamāha.
Taṃ taṃ namassāmīti taṃ evarūpaṃ taṃ namassāmi.
Niddese paccekabuddhāti taṃ taṃ ārammaṇaṃ pāṭiyekkaṃ catusaccaṃ sayameva buddhā paṭivedhappattāti paccekabuddhā.
Uddhara manti maṃ saṃsārapaṅkā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpehi.
Samuddhara manti sammā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpehi maṃ.
Athassa bhagavā attādhīnameva kathaṃkathāpamokkhaṃ oghataraṇamukhena dassento “nāhan”ti gāthamāha.
Tattha nāhaṃ sahissāmīti ahaṃ na sahissāmi na sakkomi.
Na samīhāmīti atīva payogaṃ na karomi.
Evaṃ vutte attamanataro dhotako bhagavantaṃ abhitthavamāno anusāsaniṃ yācanto “anusāsa brahme”ti gāthamāha.

Kevalañhi tattha dhammaṃ, idha santinti ayaṃ viseso.

after.title: Dhotakamāṇavasuttaniddesavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ bhagavā idampi suttaṃ arahattanikūṭeneva desesi, desanāpariyosāne ca vuttasadiso eva dhammābhisamayo ahosīti.
